name: First Flight
story: Mây found six blank pages in an old sky atlas. Catch the rings and help draw the first trail.
lesson: Click a ring to walk towards it. Jump just before the rose puddle. You can stop and look around whenever you like.
reward: The first trail glows on Mây’s atlas.

name: Paper Trail
story: Three feathers blew away from the atlas. Follow a winding trail, or take a little detour to find them all.
lesson: The next gold ring is your destination. White feathers are optional: explore the side paths before catching the last ring.
reward: The atlas now has room for curious little detours.

name: High Hopes
story: The next page is floating higher than Mây can reach. A second leap in the air might be just enough.
lesson: Jump, then press Jump again while airborne to reach the rings marked HIGH. Save the second leap until you are near the ring.
reward: Mây adds a bright silver wing to the atlas.

name: Breezy Bend
story: A playful breeze is turning the atlas pages. Watch the streamers and steer gently as you fly.
lesson: The breeze pushes you sideways while airborne. Steer against it, or use your second jump to adjust your landing.
reward: The atlas learns how to follow the wind.

name: Dancing Clouds
story: These clouds have their own little dance. Mây needs a patient explorer to find the rhythm.
lesson: Rings drift gently from side to side. Watch their motion before jumping; a second leap lets you correct your approach.
reward: Six dancing clouds find a place on the page.

name: Homeward Sky
story: One page remains. Carry everything you learned across the sky, and help Mây finish an atlas for the whole village.
lesson: Use your double jump, read the breeze, and meet each drifting ring. Feathers and a clean flight can be earned on separate replays.
reward: Mây’s sky atlas is complete. There is a path home for every friend.
